a.title: They war-gamed dimming the Sun. It went even worse than you think.

b.lede: Solar geoengineering could buy humanity time against climate change—or trigger a dangerous new arms race. A first-of-its-kind simulation offered a glimpse of what happens when geopolitics takes the wheel.
b.title: They War-Gamed Dimming the Sun. It Went Even Worse Than You Think
